issue.title: States and history graph not showing correct data when multiple entities are selected and they writing state to the state machine ~ every second

repository.name: core
repository.description: :house_with_garden: Open source home automation that puts local control and privacy first.

issue.body:
### The problem

Hi,

since the upgrade to 2023.2 I face issues with the states chart and history graph, they are showing wrong values. My god feeling says it has something to do with the new feature regarding streaming history. The issue still persists in 2023.3.1 for me.

Few examples:

The history graph showing wrong values:
![Bild 04 03 23 um 23 04](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3297891/222930852-7154270a-2735-4d77-a150-26e8cde53a35.jpg)


Where the values should be as following:
![Bild 04 03 23 um 23 04](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3297891/222930868-e7f2db74-83bb-4f62-bf3c-ec09e51bb507.jpg)

![Bild 04 03 23 um 23 05](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3297891/222930878-8f2bd946-da51-4055-9210-9ed1eca8f7a6.jpg)


Same strange behavior on states chart:
![Bild 04 03 23 um 23 03](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3297891/222930896-20898bab-fe40-4aac-a76f-ae98fcbf212b.jpg)

Picked out one entry from the chart above with correct values:

![Bild 04 03 23 um 23 03](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3297891/222930907-e5efbeec-5981-4c5c-a310-b9cdaec88e20.jpg)


Please let me know if you need more data. Do somebody else face similar behavior? 





### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

body: thanks for reporting, will try to look when i next have time

OK wow we sure spent a lot of time on this !      what a long thread.   Im not sure if i had a self contained test case for the whole thing, it looks like we added some more mutexes as we went along.  

quite simply I forgot to add some of the changes to the "main" branch that were in the 1.4 version.   I'm still trying to figure out how i missed that and what the origin of each change was but likely i will just finish the patch and taht would be it.

**Mike Bayer** has proposed a fix for this issue in the **main** branch:

**repair broken lambda patch** https://gerrit.sqlalchemy.org/c/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/+/4502

OK so I dont have your test env setup, the above patch adds the missing mutex code which also appears to change the lookup scheme used by AnalyzedCode.   if you can run the above gerrit through your environment again and make sure this fixes the issue (again), we will know we got it this time.  thanks!
99% sure that will do it. Working up a test case now

I have a reproducer.  Testing the change now

The key to making it happen again (fast) was

```
from sqlalchemy.sql import lambdas
from sqlalchemy import util

lambdas._closure_per_cache_key = util.LRUCache(1)
```
hey it turns out your reproducer at https://github.com/bdraco/issue_8098/tree/version2 still works too

It appears to pass now with the lock

..but still fails even with the lock with https://github.com/bdraco/issue_8098/tree/issue_9461 which has the LRUCache cache size lowered to 1 https://github.com/bdraco/issue_8098/blob/55825a821eff35c6c336e0e3ed4e0eb27ca4d1cf/repro.py#L11
I'm not sure that an LRU size of 1 is showing a real or problem or its because the LRU needs to be at least as large as the number of expressions being added together

issue.title: Statistics Graphs card showing only "Loading statistics..." after 2023.3.3 update

repository.name: core
repository.description: :house_with_garden: Open source home automation that puts local control and privacy first.

issue.body:
### The problem

I updated to 2023.3.3 late last night Europe/Amsterdam time (very soon after it was released) and now I find that the Statistics Graph card is having issues displaying the stats. This happens to all cards of this type. Example:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5102461/224258575-c4fec5f1-e4cc-452f-a25a-a3ca28c5b99f.png)

The entity itself is working well and reporting, also in the History:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5102461/224258784-d73c37bd-6f7c-411a-897f-38172d897984.png)

I did not change anything to the way the cards are defined, example yaml below. The issue occurs in the web app, both local and over a Cloudflared tunnel (and thus also on my Android app).

The first occurence of the log entry I found (and 148 similar items) was indeed a few seconds after the update to 2023.3.3. The log entries appear to me (non coder) to point to a bug. I haven't looked at the code and the indicated line numbers, I'm not sufficiently familiar with Python.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2023.3.3

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

2023.3.2

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

n/a (I think)

### Link to integration documentation on our website

_No response_

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
chart_type: bar
period: hour
days_to_show: 1
type: statistics-graph
entities:
  - sensor.p1_meter_3c39e728d3a6_total_power_import
  - sensor.p1_meter_3c39e728d3a6_total_power_export
stat_types:
  - change
title: Last 24 hours
```
